# `NET_HOST_REJECTED`

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | error |
| Area | [Network (`NET_`)](README.md#domain-net) |
| Reported by | `cli` |

## What happened

The local server refused a request with a foreign Host header (DNS-rebinding guard); answers 421.

## What to do

Nothing to do if you didn't expect it: a web page tried to reach your local server. Use `127.0.0.1` or `localhost`.
